intro.label: Who we are
intro.title: Airport dining, built around how people travel
intro.body: TGU operates restaurants, cafés and lounges in airports and travel hubs across China. Instead of a single house brand, we build a portfolio matched to each terminal's travelers and traffic, then run it with teams who know how airports work. That gives travelers genuinely better choices, and gives airports and brand partners an operation that performs.

company.title: Who we are
company.subtitle: A leading travel food & beverage operator in Asia
company.heading: A different model for airport dining
body: TGU operates restaurants, cafés and lounges in airports and travel hubs across China. The company was founded in 2018 by Li Yang, a veteran of the travel food and beverage industry, with capital provided by Artal Group,  a long-term investment holding group, and strategic support from Invus, as the exclusive investment advisor of Artal Group.

Terminals are difficult places to run a restaurant: kitchens are small, service windows are short, and passenger flows shift by the hour. TGU was built for those conditions. We curate a brand portfolio for each terminal, adapt every concept to the way it will actually be used, and hold the same operating standards across all of our sites.

In seven years we have brought the first Michelin two-star restaurant brand into a Chinese airport and assembled a roster of close to 100 Chinese and international brands, many of them Michelin-recognized. Airport operators have recognized that work with repeated awards.

items.desc: Led by Li Yang and backed by Invus, a team of travel F&B veterans founded TGU to become a leading travel dining company.
The first locations opened at Shanghai Pudong Airport and performed strongly from the start.
Strengthened operations through the pandemic and entered several new airports with restaurants and lounges.
The first international-terminal restaurant opened at Pudong and ranked among the airport's top performers.
Locations in Beijing Capital's international terminal became benchmarks in their categories.
Expanded into second-tier hubs including Guiyang, Wuxi and Hangzhou.

leadership.title: Leadership team
leadership.subtitle: An international team with airport operating experience
leadership.intro: TGU's senior team comes from aviation, airport retail and premium hospitality. They combine international management experience with the ability to execute in the Chinese market, working across strategy, commercial development and operations to get dining brands open and running well inside complex travel hubs.

points.title: Deep aviation expertise
points.body: Senior members of the team have held management roles at the International Air Transport Association (IATA), Air China and UPS. That background shapes how we read passenger needs, service standards and the daily realities of a travel hub.

points.title: Proven commercial expertise
points.body: Team members have worked in business development at international travel dining operators including SSP and HMSHost. They have led major airport tenders and brought new brands into terminals, turning traffic patterns and passenger profiles into brand portfolios that make commercial sense.

points.title: Operational expertise at scale
points.body: The team has run close to 20 chain brands and more than 40 outlets across multiple formats in Shanghai and Beijing, and has supported the planning and daily food and beverage operations of several airline lounges.

investor.title: Our investor
investor.subtitle: Backed by a global evergreen investor
investor.body: TGU has partnered with Invus, the exclusive investment advisor of Artal Group, a long-term investment holding group with over $10 billion under management. Founded in 1985, Invus invests with a long-term horizon and works alongside management teams and aspires to build industry transformative businesses. Invus has investment teams in the United States, Europe and Asia, and has supported consumer, technology and healthcare companies globally. As a long-term partner, Invus and Artal Group support TGU with patient capital, strategic guidance and access to a global network of brand and operating relationships.

item1.desc: We are changing what travelers expect from airport dining. That comes down to detail: how food is sourced, how quickly it reaches the table, and how consistent it is from one shift to the next.

item2.title: An international team
item2.desc: TGU is international by design. Our people come from different countries and backgrounds, and that range is part of how we run a business built around travelers from everywhere.

item3.title: Open and collaborative
item3.desc: We keep the organization flat and communication direct, so good ideas move quickly and people can see the effect of their work. Careers here grow with the business.

overview.title: What we do
overview.bannerDesc: We replace one-size-fits-all airport dining with a portfolio built terminal by terminal, so travelers get genuine choice on every trip.
overview.body: TGU runs food and beverage operations in airports and travel hubs. Traditional airport dining tends to work the other way around: sites are taken as they come, and the same handful of brands turns up in every terminal. We start from the terminal instead. We look at who travels through it and when, build a brand mix to match, and then operate those sites ourselves. Curating, composing and operating as one process is what makes the model work for travelers, brand partners and airports at the same time.

winwin.title: For travelers
winwin.desc: More choice and more authentic food on every trip.

winwin.title: For brands
winwin.desc: A way into the airport market, from securing the site to running it.

winwin.title: For airports
winwin.desc: Higher sales per square meter and better dining quality in the same space.

portfolio.desc: Every traveler moves at a different pace and wants something different to eat. To cover that range, TGU has assembled a library of more than 70 food and beverage brands: Michelin-starred Chinese dining, authentic Asian cooking, casual Western restaurants, quick-service formats and dessert concepts. The mix runs all day and across categories, so time in the terminal becomes something better than waiting.

hero.title: Our Brands Gallery
hero.desc: A closer look at the spaces we build and the brands we run. Each store has its own character, and each one is designed for the way people actually use a terminal.

eggbomb.name: EGG BOMB
eggbomb.taglineMain: The terminal's first made-to-order hot sandwich
eggbomb.taglineSub: Portable, quick, and one of our strongest performers per square meter
eggbomb.intro: EGG BOMB works from a simple idea: global formats, Chinese flavors. It created the made-to-order hot sandwich category inside airport terminals, combining Asian tastes with international trends. Everything is built when it is ordered, which keeps the flavor consistent while cutting the wait down to something that fits a boarding schedule. A distinctive look and a tight operating model have made it one of the strongest performers per square meter in the terminals where it operates.

canton8.name: Canton 8
canton8.taglineMain: Michelin-starred Cantonese, now in the terminal
canton8.taglineSub: Classic Cantonese cooking, without the rush
canton8.intro: Canton 8 brings Michelin-starred Cantonese cooking into the terminal: careful sourcing, traditional technique and a room that does not feel like an airport. From classic roast meats to seasonal seafood, the kitchen holds the standards the brand is known for, which changes what a sit-down meal before a flight can be.

googse.name: Goose Island
googse.taglineMain: Chicago craft beer, right at the gate
googse.taglineSub: A relaxed pour before you fly
googse.intro: Goose Island started in Chicago and is now one of the better-known craft breweries in the world. In the terminal it keeps the same unfussy pub feel, with a rotating list of core and limited releases alongside American bar food — a straightforward way to slow down before a flight.

segafredo.name: Segafredo Caffe
segafredo.taglineMain: Italian specialty coffee in the terminal
segafredo.intro: Segafredo Caffe brings Italian specialty coffee into the airport, with consistent preparation and quick service for travelers who are departing or connecting.

wangshifu.name: Wong Shifu
wangshifu.slogan: Hunan stir-fries with real wok flavor
wangshifu.taglineMain: Hunan cooking, straight from the wok
wangshifu.intro: Wong Shifu is built around Hunan cooking and dishes fired fresh in the wok, balancing real wok flavor with the speed an airport requires — a proper hot Chinese meal that still fits the schedule.
